task_completion.description: Load the PDB structure 1UBQ into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '1UBQ' and the 3D viewer displays the ubiquitin protein structure.

task_completion.description: Enable solvent-accessible area calculations in PyMOL (e.g., setting dot_solvent to 1).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history shows commands like 'set dot_solvent, 1' or 'get_area' being executed.

task_completion.description: Calculate SASA for the 7 specific lysine residues (K6, K11, K27, K29, K33, K48, K63).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history or external terminal shows the agent selecting or iterating through residues 6, 11, 27, 29, 33, 48, and 63 to compute area values.

task_completion.description: Create a text report at ~/PyMOL_Data/ubiquitin_lysine_report.txt with SASA values sorted in descending order.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows a file containing the 7 lysines and their numerical SASA values, ordered from highest to lowest.

task_completion.description: Represent the protein as a grey or white surface with lysines as distinct colored spheres.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows a grey/white molecular surface with specific residues (lysines) rendered as spheres in a contrasting color (e.g., red).

task_completion.description: Save a high-resolution ray-traced image to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ubq_lysines.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history shows a 'ray' command followed by a 'png' command targeting the specified file path.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL GUI or command line interface rather than just creating files manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with the 1UBQ structure loaded and commands being typed into the PyMOL prompt.

integrity.description: The agent derived SASA values from PyMOL calculations rather than copy-pasting them from external sources.
integrity.visual_evidence: The command history shows the 'get_area' command (or similar) being run for the specific lysine selections.

integrity.description: The agent used the exact file paths specified in the task for the report and the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal or PyMOL commands show the paths '~/PyMOL_Data/ubiquitin_lysine_report.txt' and '~/PyMOL_Data/images/ubq_lysines.png' being used.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The protein 1UBQ contains exactly 7 lysines at sequence positions 6, 11, 27, 29, 33, 48, and 63. To calculate SASA in PyMOL, the agent should use 'set dot_solvent, 1' followed by 'get_area'. The final report must be sorted descending by the calculated area values. The image must show a grey/white surface with these 7 residues highlighted as spheres.
